read_file.description: Read text file; line-numbered output `LINE|content`, 1-based. Partial reads via start_line/length (default 200, max 2000).

path.description: File to read; relative resolves from workspace root, e.g. `memory/MEMORY.md`.

write_file.description: Write file; creates parent dirs. overwrite=true replaces the ENTIRE file. JSON escaping applies: \n newline, \\n literal backslash-n.

path.description: File to write; relative resolves from workspace root, e.g. `memory/MEMORY.md`.

content.description: Content to write; JSON escaping applies: \n newline, \\n literal backslash-n.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file in full; discards current contents. Default false.

list_dir.description: List files and dirs in a folder.

path.description: Folder to list; relative resolves from workspace root, e.g. `memory`.

grep.description: Search file contents for a keyword; narrow by path/ext. Max matches default 50, max 200.

path.description: File or folder to search; relative resolves from workspace root.

keyword.description: Text to find in file contents.

ext.description: Only files with this extension (e.g. txt); empty means all.

edit_file.description: Replace old_string with new_string; old_string must match exactly once. JSON escaping applies: \n newline, \\n literal backslash-n.

path.description: File to edit; relative resolves from workspace root.

old_string.description: Exact text to find; must exist exactly once in the file.

new_string.description: Replacement text; empty string deletes the match.

append_file.description: Append content to end of file; creates it when absent. JSON escaping applies: \n newline, \\n literal backslash-n.

path.description: File to append to; relative resolves from workspace root.

content.description: Content to append; JSON escaping applies: \n newline, \\n literal backslash-n.

run_shell_command.description: Run shell in workspace. background=true returns a sessionId; manage via poll/read/kill/list.

action.description: run: execute command; list: show sessions; poll: check status; read: get output; kill: terminate.

sessionId.description: Session ID from a background run; required for poll/read/kill.

background.description: Run in background immediately; default false.

telegram_sendfile.description: Send a local file (image, document, etc.) to the current Telegram chat; max 20MB.

path.description: Local file to send; relative resolves from workspace root.

filename.description: Display filename; default base name of path.

telegram_getuser.description: Telegram user info (name, username, id, bio) for a user ID; omit for current sender.

user_id.description: User ID to look up; omit for current sender.

get_env.description: Runtime env: workspace, platform, Go version, memory usage.

web_fetch.description: Fetch URL; HTML stripped to readable text. Public http/https only; no local/private hosts. Paginate via start_line/length (default 100, max 1000).

section.description: text: stripped plain text; html: raw HTML.

web_search.description: Search current web; returns titles, URLs, snippets. Count default 5, max 10.

manage_schedule.description:
Schedule, inspect, and update reminders, tasks, or agent prompts.
Reminder/schedule request: you MUST call this tool.
Types: once (run_once_at), every (every_seconds, recurring only), daily (daily_time), cron (cron_expr).

action.description: add, list, get, update, remove, enable, disable. Use get before editing; update changes a job without losing its payload.

name.description: Job display name; optional for add/update.

prompt.description: Instruction the agent executes when the job triggers.

type.description: Schedule type: once, every, daily, cron.

every_seconds.description: Recurring interval seconds (3600 = hourly); recurring tasks only.

weekdays.description: Days the job runs (e.g. ["mon","fri"]); omit for every day.

end_at.description: Stop time after which the job no longer runs (e.g. 2026-10-05 00:00).

days.description: Days the job stays active; 0 = no end.

use_skill.description: Activate a skill by name; its instructions load into the Active Skills section.

always_active.description: Keep active across turns; default false = current turn only, deactivated after the final answer.
